verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Canny offers an embeddable web widget (canny-docs-17), but nothing documents customizing the widget's label or colors to match a brand. The llms.txt probe cuts off at "widget cu", which is too incomplete to count as affirmative support. Missing for 10: documented label customization, documented color/theming options for the widget.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can customize the feedback widget's label and colors to match my brand
